briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: This hour, we saw multiple developments in ongoing investigations and new cases of fraud. Robert P. Rubicco, a daycare operator, was charged with fraud and imminent danger. Aimee Bock, a nonprofit fraud ringleader, was sentenced to nearly 42 years in prison.
